title_as_printed: Isopiestic molalities m and the corresponding osmotic coefficients phi for CaCl2(aq)
pressure_note: not stated in the table; isopiestic equilibrium at the solution vapour pressure (saturation); no pressure value given

value.what: molality of the reference electrolyte NaCl(aq) in isopiestic equilibrium with the CaCl2(aq) solution of the same row

value2.what: calculated by the authors from phi_NaCl (Pitzer et al. equations) via phi_x = 2 phi_s m_s / (3 m_x)

composition.other_species: reference electrolyte NaCl in the second solution (molality in 'm NaCl mol/kg'); the two solutions are separate, not mixed

extra_unmapped: phi (CaCl2) is the CaCl2 osmotic coefficient derived by the authors from the NaCl reference, kept as value2
conversion_needs: T per label row; the CaCl2 osmotic coefficient depends on the NaCl osmotic coefficient model (Pitzer et al.) used by the authors
notes: Printed as three side-by-side column groups (phi, m CaCl2, m NaCl) under each temperature heading; stacked per temperature block as left group, middle group, right group (top to bottom). The 523.20 K block runs over the page break (journal p. 274 to 275). Isopiestic temperatures are mean temperatures of each equilibrium set. Printed value 0.2759 for m CaCl2 at 473.61 K (phi 0.9531, m NaCl 3.4532) is almost certainly a misprint for 2.2759 (neighbouring rows 2.2788 / 3.4560); kept as printed.

row_held.reason: m CaCl2 printed 0.2759 at 473.61 K; back-calculation of the NaCl reference coefficient indicates 2.2759 (0.114 vs 0.943); likely misprint; held (mapping audit 2026-10-02)
